mentions.name: ReplicaSafe
mentions.description: A Redis real-time backup platform with point-in-time recovery (PITR) to the exact millisecond. Besides downloads, it offers an emergency recovery option where the Redis client connects directly to the master-replica to receive the latest version. It includes a key explorer for changing data on the fly and receiving real-time notifications when a condition is met (e.g., a value contains X). Built in Rust on bare metal with isolation between clients and data.
